integrity: Analytic spectral proof plus standalone exact-symbolic and finite-graph corroboration; finite tests do not certify arbitrary graphs. Literature priority is qualified, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only bipartition-constant nonhomogeneous equilibria on finite connected undirected bipartite graphs with degree-normalized exchange and logistic multiplier four; global basins, other states, and nonlinear dynamics at neutral boundaries are not claimed.
title: Graph-independent sharp stability window for stationary logistic checkerboards
